Uttar Pradesh Police Officer Accused of Theft After Truck Driver's Chase

A truck driver in Uttar Pradesh pursued a police officer for 13 kilometers after alleging the officer took Rs 20,000. A video of the chase has gone viral, drawing attention to the incident. The allegations and the subsequent chase have raised questions about police conduct.
